# You Noah Lab

> You Noah Lab (https://younoahlab.com) is a free interactive science lab for kids aged about 7 to 13. It runs in any web browser, with 13 hands-on virtual labs and NOAH, an AI guide (a computer program, not a person) who opens labs and answers science questions from checked reference data.

Key facts:
- Free to use. No ads, no trackers, no account needed.
- Everything is virtual. Real-world experiments need a grown-up.
- NOAH answers only from data that ships with the page. If NOAH has no checked data for a question, it says so.
- Made by You Noah Guy.

## Labs
- [Element Explorer](https://younoahlab.com/#elem): All 118 elements, real data, trading cards
- [Sound Studio](https://younoahlab.com/#sound): Make REAL sound waves you can hear
- [Circuits](https://younoahlab.com/#circ): Build circuits with live V = I × R
- [Chemistry Bench](https://younoahlab.com/#chem): Mix real reactions: fizz, foam and flame tests
- [Light & Optics](https://younoahlab.com/#light): Bend light with a prism using real Snell's law
- [Matter & Plasma](https://younoahlab.com/#matter): Heat atoms from frozen solid all the way to plasma
- [Magnet Lab](https://younoahlab.com/#magnet): Field lines, a compass and electromagnets
- [Crystals & Metals](https://younoahlab.com/#crystal): Grow crystals, test and mix real metals
- [DNA & Genetics](https://younoahlab.com/#dna): Build proteins and breed creatures for real
- [Human Body](https://younoahlab.com/#body): Test YOUR real reaction time and more
- [Nature](https://younoahlab.com/#nature): Food webs, photosynthesis and growing plants
- [Mad Ideas Lab](https://younoahlab.com/#mad): Challenge the laws of physics!
- [Lab Journal](https://younoahlab.com/#jrnl): Your findings, reports and certificate
